line_set.name: bynli_lines_v3
line_set.hocrgen_branch: fix/f8f-lines-v3 (this PR; adds hocrgen#169 alternate editions and the per-trailer pby_body fix)
line_set.command:
#!/bin/sh
# bynli_lines_v3 build (R8). Run from a hocrgen checkout at commit 93a413f.
set -e
F=$T/real-source-mapping/intermediates/f8f
PYTHONPATH=src ~/clones/hocrgen/.venv/bin/python -m hocrgen.tools.benyehuda_nli_lines build $T/s16c-glyph-scale/outputs/lines/bynli_lines_v3 \
  --root $F/f8f_g --root $F/f8f_g/ia_reprobe \
  --root $F/f8f_r8_lines/roots/f8f_ia_r8 --root $F/f8f_r8_lines/roots/f8f3_r8 \
  --exclude-records-from $F/f8f_r8_lines/v2_manifest_records.txt \
  --prefer-placer stock --max-lines-per-book 6100 --drop-pointed-spans \
  --node-hints $F/f8f_r8_lines/node_hints.json \
  --pointed ahalrefaimshir00liliuoft dimdumimshirim00katz seferhashirim00hein bub_gb_5-Y-AQAAIAAJ nirdavid02coheuoft shirathayaatahme00long_0 \
  --dev 990010106660205171=bodek-1865 nirdavid02coheuoft=nir-david-1834-ia bub_gb_5-Y-AQAAIAAJ=nir-david-1834-google kolkitvereuvenbe11brai=brainin-collected-works \
        990010684570205171=bodek-1870 nirdavid01coheuoft=nir-david-1834 990020250940205171=silman-1929 990018546440205171=brainin-1928 \
  --summary-note "proposed_node_hint is a hint only (decision 0018): the maintainer's tagger decides each unit's node. His own first tagging was far stricter (22 of 25 units old printed, incl. Brainin 1928), so the new_printed counts here are not settled." \
  --summary-note "Source tags new_printed for 19th- and early-20th-century book type were kept unchanged (zikhronotlebetda01reck 1893, zikhronotlevetda01frie 1904, sipurim00nombuoft 1905, kolkitveylkatsen018800 1905, yotsrehasifrutha00zitr 1922, kolkitvereuvenbe11brai 1922, seferhademaotmeo0000bern 1923); they likely overstate new printed." \
  --summary-note "No dev unit is designated new-printed dev: that role waits for the maintainer's tagging."
